disclosure.plan: BENCHMARK_PLAN.md §2 disclosure, §3 S-CFG-01, §4 metrics, §5 bias controls

scenario.load: HTTP/1.1, one connection per request, 1 KiB response, closed-loop workers
phases: baseline: before the operator writes the new config
reload: from just before SIGHUP through the declared window
scenario.note: A->B routing is proven by a real probe; errors during reload are data.

disclosure.topology: one host; two origins, both proxies and generator are containers on benchv092cfg; no host ports published

reload.mechanism: atomic config replace + SIGHUP; EQProxy re-gates in place; HAProxy replaces its worker
reload.haproxy_config: backend server A -> B; stats socket used only to read counters
reload.verification: a new request through the proxy must return marker b

differences: EQProxy swaps in place; HAProxy's master starts a new worker and drains the old one
one connection per request; established-connection draining is not measured by this harness
no TLS, rules, rewrites or compression

calibration.reason: direct origin 2.204x faster than the faster proxy

S-CFG-01.note: HAProxy's worker replacement resets its stats; reported separately, not used as a performance win.
